items.markdown:
A number cake is `a custom-shaped or sheet-baked dessert designed to celebrate milestones like birthdays and anniversaries` . They range from elegant multi-tiered "tart cakes" layered with buttercream and topped with fruit or macarons to classic sheet cakes with colorful themed piping.[](https://thecupcakefactory.com.au/collections/letter-and-number-cakes) [[1]](https://thecupcakefactory.com.au/collections/letter-and-number-cakes)[[2]](https://www.caitlyncakedesign.com.au/shop/number-cake)[[3]](https://www.fergusonplarre.com.au/number-sheet-cake)

Buying a Number Cake in Sydney

If you want to order one rather than DIY, several local bakers and bakeries offer customizable number cakes:

- **The Cupcake Factory:** Delivers Sydney-wide (Monday–Saturday) or offers pickups in Artarmon. You can fully customize the color, theme, and digits. Browse their [Letter & Number Cakes Shop](https://thecupcakefactory.com.au/collections/letter-and-number-cakes?srsltid=AfmBOooBttXiMWqsXf-uwmGgjsUd2rD_rLWzNENILwKiN_GWhff1Npql).[[1]](https://thecupcakefactory.com.au/collections/letter-and-number-cakes)
- **Cute Cakes & Co:** Offers Petite (5–10 servings) and Grand (10–20 servings) sizes with customizable color palettes. Order via the [Cute Cakes & Co Number Cakes Page](https://cutecakesandco.com.au/collections/number-cakes?srsltid=AfmBOop-uoYmeXTrnkJWvQ9ieiZz9nDIUS6hdvBMphUpCSaibFmiMsHf).[[1]](https://cutecakesandco.com.au/collections/number-cakes)[[2]](https://www.caitlyncakedesign.com.au/shop/number-cake)
- **Caitlyn Cake Design:** Perfect for milestone events, their standard single-digit cakes come decorated with florals and macarons. Check out their [Caitlyn Cake Design Shop](https://www.caitlyncakedesign.com.au/shop/number-cake).[[1]](https://www.caitlyncakedesign.com.au/shop/number-cake)

DIY Number Cake Guide If you're baking at home, you don't even need to buy specialty number tins:[](https://www.sugarologie.com/number-cake-templates) [[1]](https://www.sugarologie.com/number-cake-templates)[[2]](https://www.spotlightstores.com/en-au/ideas/create/creating-kids-birthday-cakes)

1. **The Template Method:** Bake standard large square or rectangular sheet cakes. Find and print number templates online, place them on the cooled cake, and use a paring knife to carefully trace and cut out your digits.[](https://www.sugarologie.com/number-cake-templates) [[1]](https://www.sugarologie.com/number-cake-templates)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/RSAijhdKqEI)[[3]](https://www.spotlightstores.com/en-au/ideas/create/creating-kids-birthday-cakes)
2. **Layering & Decorating:** Stack the cut-out sponge layers with rich buttercream or whipped cream.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:17557421972227092977,catalogid:17378861942610225255,gpcid:13961587572983502766,mid:576462871283168785&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:1343360762271438765,catalogid:12185376163782304047,gpcid:17217982132321225801&ibp=oshop)
3. **The Finishing Touches:** Elevate the cake by piping dollops of cream on top and adding premium toppings like fresh berries, macarons, custom chocolates, or edible flowers.[](https://thecupcakefactory.com.au/collections/letter-and-number-cakes) [[1]](https://thecupcakefactory.com.au/collections/letter-and-number-cakes)[[2]](https://www.caitlyncakedesign.com.au/shop/number-cake)
